svg.text: Full-stack developer with 3+ years shipping production software for enterprise SaaS and
the iGaming industry: Python backends (Django, FastAPI, Flask), Java services and modern
JavaScript frontends, on PostgreSQL, MySQL and MongoDB.
I started in engineering (MSc Biological & Bioprocess Engineering, University of
Sheffield; BEng Chemical Engineering, Lancaster University), building computational
models and optimising complex systems. I bring the same approach to software: understand
the problem, design it properly, then build it.
I work across the full stack, from APIs and backend services to web and mobile
frontends, with Django, FastAPI, Next.js and Flutter.
OPEN TO FRONT-END OR FULL-STACK ROLES · EU / UK · REMOTE-FRIENDLY
